verdict.rationale: LibreOffice's official CLI documents batch conversion in one headless run: `--convert-to pdf:writer_pdf_Export --outdir /home/user *.doc` takes a wildcard file list, and `--print-to-file` batch-prints to an output directory. A community user also runs it in Docker to normalize document formats. The evidence never shows per-file success/failure reporting, so the second half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented per-file result/status output or error reporting, explicit folder-recursion support, independent hands-on corroboration of large batch runs.
